QuestInfo.name: [Rose Garden] Stop and Smell the Roses
QuestInfo.0: #bIfia#k on the #bRoof of the Fifth Tower#k of the Lion King's Castle has more to share. She wants you to meet someone...
QuestInfo.1: Ifia asked you to talk to #bCecilia#k, the caretaker of the Rose Garden.
QuestInfo.2: You spoke to to Cecilia on behalf of Ifia.

0.0: Forgive me, but I have one last request... Please talk to\n#bCecilia#k. She was the caretaker of my beloved Rose Garden. I'm certain she must be very lonely.\r\n#fNpc/2162000.img/stand/0#

yes.0: Thank you. Just have a word with her, would you?\r\n#b(Go to the Rose Garden and talk to Cecilia the gardener.)#k

no.0: Is it too much to ask?

1.0: Hm? Who are you? What would a living person like you be doing here?
1.1: I bet Ifia put you up to this... She's always had such a good heart. And I suppose you do, too. It gets...rather lonely around here.\r\n
1.2: This place used to be so beautiful. His Highness gave this place to Ifia as his gift, but just like the rest of this accursed castle, it's fallen to the monsters.\r\n
1.3: I spent my life caring for this place. To see the garden trampled so, it just...it makes my blood boil! Or it would, if I had any.\r\n

yes.0: Let this be a lesson to you. Appreciate the beauty in your life, because who knows what will happen to it when you pass on. And if you're unlucky like me...you get to see it destroyed firsthand.

npc.0: Please give Cecilia my regards.\r\n#b(Go to the Rose Garden.)#k
